name: mri_prostate
description: Order a prostate MRI (multiparametric MRI — mpMRI) for prostate cancer detection, localization, and staging using PI-RADS scoring.

region.description: Body region to image — focused on the prostate gland

contrast.description: Contrast requirement — mpMRI includes both pre- and post-contrast sequences

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., elevated PSA, prior negative biopsy, staging)

when_to_use: elevated PSA with prior negative systematic biopsy (MRI-guided targeted biopsy)
initial prostate cancer detection before first biopsy
active surveillance of low-risk prostate cancer
pre-treatment local staging of known prostate cancer

examples.query: 62-year-old male with PSA 8.5, prior negative 12-core biopsy

args.clinical_indication: elevated PSA with prior negative biopsy, MRI for targeted biopsy planning
